description: What a lot can hold by right, from the letter of its zoning code applied to the real parcel outline: units, buildable floor area, height, floors, and setbacks. `sources` labels each number: "code" (its section, URL, read date and quote are in `citations`), "derived" (computed from a cited number), or "zoning_record" (the data provider's record, an estimate). Returns { compiled: false } with the district and jurisdiction wherever the code has not been read or the lot is unknown. Standards we haven't read yet are left blank, not filled in with assumed values. Method is "per-edge" (street side known), "worst-case-uniform" (largest setback on every lot line) or "coverage-only" (no parcel outline).

address.description: US street address, e.g. "412 Oak St, Austin, TX".

response_format.description: "concise" (default) leaves out factor notes and verbatim code quotes; every number keeps its source and read date. "detailed" returns them.

name: envelope

citations.description: Per rule: value, section, url, read date and quote.

cite.description: One sentence to quote: the Score, its band, the address, any cap and the newest read date.

compiled.description: False wherever the district's code has not been read, or the lot is unknown; reason says which.

district_rules.description: On an uncompiled envelope, where the Atlas publishes the district: its cited standards, as zoning_district returns them (district rules, not applied to this lot).

links.description: score_page: the address's public Score page, the link to cite. check_project: the checker, seeded with the address. atlas: the district's Atlas page. Each only when that page exists.

sources.description: Per number: "code" (cited in citations), "derived", or "zoning_record" (an estimate).

title: By-right building envelope
